assets.prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset: portrait 9:16 hero photograph for a premium motivation app's paywall, 1080x1920 composition. Theme: where this leads, the payoff of steady small decisions. Scene: at a rough stone lookout after an uphill morning walk, a woman in her late 30s wearing a plain dark slate jacket and practical trousers stands quietly with her back to the camera, overlooking a vast green valley and distant blue ridgelines. She has arrived by her own effort, relaxed but grounded. No triumphant arms or staged yoga pose. Subject small, in upper middle-right of frame, all anatomy natural and hands relaxed at her sides. Camera at waist height from behind at a generous environmental distance. Foreground wet textured stone and dark green grasses, midground sunlit valley, background pale cool blue morning sky with thin broken clouds. Natural morning light from out of frame, clear daylight and real deep forest greens, steel blue distant mountains, neutral grey stone; a little warm cream light on the shoulder and horizon. Clearly bright and hopeful, but cinematic contrast, dark textured foreground, real photographic realism and slight film grain. Not postcard, not golden-hour sunset, not pastel stock. Keep at least 12 percent safe crop margin on every edge and clean darker stone/grass negative space across the bottom 35 percent for separate UI overlay copy. No text whatsoever, no letters, numbers, logos, branding, signage, watermark, frames or borders. No close-up face; no strange or extra limbs, no distorted hands. Output one finished standalone vertical image only, no collage.
assets.scene: Woman at a rough mountain lookout over a green valley and lake
assets.palette: forest green, steel blue, neutral grey, cream morning light
